items.title: Steel Tariffs Are Working Even as Imports Rise, Nucor CEO Says
items.summary: Nucor shares are up 6% today after strong quarterly results that Chief Executive Leon Topalian credited to President Trump’s aggressive use of tariffs, despite an uptick in steel imports.  “Vigorous enforcement of our trade laws is curtailing the flood of unfairly traded steel into the U.S. market,” Topalian said during a conference call.
